name: Shi ga Futari o Betsuritsutomo
original_name: 死が二人を別離つとも
source:
There is a rumor in my town. It is said that the town is haunted by the ghost of a girl in a school uniform who died unnoticed in a vacant lot on the outskirts. She is said to be unable to accept her death, and continues to wander around with people who were close to her before her death.

This is a love-hate drama about girls in a small town in the countryside.

[Translated from [url=https://pchan2.itch.io/deathdepeartsus]itch.io[/url]]
